stories.desc_en: Microsoft is looking to sell its in-house AI models as more efficient and cost-effective than its competitors' models.
stories.desc_zh: 微软正在寻求以比竞争对手的模型更高效、更具成本效益的方式销售其内部人工智能模型。

stories.title_en: Amid hardware legal battle, OpenAI releases a $230 keyboard for Codex
stories.title_zh: Amid hardware legal battle, OpenAI releases a $230 keyboard for Codex
stories.desc_en: OpenAI, which is in the middle of a legal battle with Apple over hardware trade theft allegations, just released a light-up keyboard designed to be paired with its agentic coding app.
stories.desc_zh: OpenAI正在与苹果就硬件贸易盗窃指控进行法律纠纷，刚刚发布了一款发光键盘，旨在与其代理编码应用程序配对。

stories.title_en: SpaceX falls to $135 IPO price ahead of Starship launch
stories.title_zh: SpaceX falls to $135 IPO price ahead of Starship launch
stories.desc_en: The stock has steadily fallen from the euphoric post-IPO high, showing that markets may be sobering up to the promises CEO Elon Musk made before and after SpaceX went public.
stories.desc_zh: 该股从IPO后的高点稳步下跌，表明市场可能正在清醒地兑现首席执行官埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)在SpaceX上市前后做出的承诺。

stories.title_en: Thinking Machines amps up its bet against one-size-fits-all AI with its first open model, Inkling
stories.title_zh: Thinking Machines amps up its bet against one-size-fits-all AI with its first open model, Inkling
stories.desc_en: It's the company's first public proof point after a year and a half spent building AI infrastructure largely out of public view.
stories.desc_zh: 这是该公司在花了一年半的时间在公众视野之外构建人工智能基础设施之后的第一个公开证明点。

stories.title_en: Hack suggests AI music generator Suno scraped YouTube for training data
stories.title_zh: Hack suggests AI music generator Suno scraped YouTube for training data
stories.desc_en: The hacker used an employee's credentials to access source code, which revealed how Suno scraped decades of audio.
stories.desc_zh: 黑客使用员工的凭据来访问源代码，这揭示了Suno如何抓取数十年的音频。

stories.title_en: Victoria Beckham Beauty Hosts Immersive Pop-up Experience Inside New York’s Caffe Paradiso
stories.title_zh: Victoria Beckham Beauty Hosts Immersive Pop-up Experience Inside New York’s Caffe Paradiso
stories.desc_en: The in-person activation will serve as a point to discover one of the brand's signature scents: Portofino '97.
stories.desc_zh: 亲临现场激活将成为探索该品牌标志性香水之一的亮点： 97年柏涛菲诺（ Portofino '97 ）。

stories.title_en: From Skin Care to Sip Care: Symbiome Team Launches Hopkind, a Functional Non-Alcoholic Beer
stories.title_zh: From Skin Care to Sip Care: Symbiome Team Launches Hopkind, a Functional Non-Alcoholic Beer
stories.desc_en: Hopkind combines traditional brewing with functional ingredients for muscle recovery and hydration.
stories.desc_zh: Hopkind将传统酿造与功能性成分相结合，用于肌肉恢复和补水。

stories.title_en: How Neutrogena Is Rebuilding for the New Generation
stories.title_zh: How Neutrogena Is Rebuilding for the New Generation
stories.desc_en: A window into the brand’s second-half strategy, including a recent retinol launch and a communications platform called Break the Rules.
stories.desc_zh: 了解品牌下半年战略的窗口，包括最近推出的视黄醇和一个名为“打破规则”的沟通平台。

stories.title_en: Alex Choueiri Named CEO of Bluemercury
stories.title_zh: Alex Choueiri Named CEO of Bluemercury
stories.desc_en: The former Kering Beauté Americas CEO and L’Oréal veteran is joining the beauty retailer, which is owned by Macy's Inc.
stories.desc_zh: 这位前开云美容美洲首席执行官和欧莱雅资深人士将加入这家美容零售商，该公司隶属于梅西百货公司（ Macy's Inc. ）。
